prompts.dog:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Game Boy Color production player sprite sheet.
Create Negro Matapacos, a side-facing Chilean black street dog with a pointed muzzle, upright triangular ear, lean torso, long tail, and red neck bandana. Every pose faces RIGHT.
EXACT layout: a square image representing a 64 x 64 logical-pixel canvas, enlarged by an integer nearest-neighbor scale. Divide it invisibly into FOUR columns and FOUR rows of 16 x 16 logical-pixel cells, with NO gutters or grid lines. Twelve sprites in the first three rows; the fourth row is completely transparent. Each dog fits its 16x16 cell with paws at logical row 14. The dog should fill about 14 pixels wide by 12 pixels tall, with 1 pixel margin.
Read left to right: row 1 idle neutral, idle tail raised, run contact, run passing; row 2 run airborne stretched, run recoil, jump rising legs tucked, jump falling forelegs down; row 3 bark muzzle open, bark bandana flutter, hurt crouch, sit celebratory.
Strict real 16x16 sprite design, chunky single logical-pixel clusters, 1990s handheld pixel art. ONLY transparent background plus THREE opaque colors: near-black #18202c fur, cool light-gray #9cacc4 highlight, saturated vermilion #ee493f bandana. Gray eye and muzzle highlight; never brown fur. Keep red a visible 2-3 pixel neck accent. Use exactly the same dog proportions across frames; vary legs/tail deliberately so the run cycles animate. No text, labels, panels, checkerboard artwork, drop shadows, gradients, antialiasing, outlines around cells, frames, scenery, or extra sprites. This is an atlas of exact low-resolution sprites, not detailed high-resolution illustrations.
prompts.actors:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Game Boy Color character and effect sprite atlas for Negro Matapacos.
EXACT square layout: FOUR equal columns and FOUR equal rows, no gutters, representing a native 64x64 logical pixel canvas enlarged crisply. Each cell is EXACTLY a 16x16 logical-pixel sprite on genuine transparency. All sixteen cells filled, with 1 pixel of transparent margin, feet at row 14 for people. No captions or grid lines.
Row 1: four frames of the SAME Carabinero facing right: patrol contact, patrol passing, stunned crouch, climbing ladder. Simplified olive-green uniform and cap, dark ink outlines, warm skin. ONLY THREE opaque colors for this entire row: #18202c, #688454, #e8b884.
Row 2: student with red shirt idle, same student waving, student with teal shirt idle, same teal student waving. Plain everyday clothing, friendly proportions. For each sprite only THREE opaque colors: #18202c outline/legs, #e8b884 face/hand, and either #ee493f red or #58a89c teal shirt.
Row 3: eight-pixel crescent empanada centered, a small dog-head extra-life icon, a red triangular checkpoint pennant on thin pole, a bright stun star. Each uses three opaque colors maximum.
Row 4: small bark wave, larger bark wave, small dust puff, larger dust puff; EACH uses transparent background and ONLY #18202c, #9cacc4, #f8e8c0.
Style: true 1990s 16x16 handheld sprite craft, severe low resolution, single block pixels, high readability; no tiny face details. Every cell centered independently. No antialiasing, gradients, shadow beneath characters, scenery, weapons, captions, labels, borders, baked checkerboard, extra items, or frames. Match a cute but lean black dog with red bandana game.
prompts.actors_correction: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the top-right cell of this 4x4 transparent sprite atlas: REMOVE the vertical ladder completely, leaving the olive-uniformed officer's climbing pose with raised hand and bent knees on a genuinely transparent background. Keep the officer intact in that cell. Keep all other fifteen sprites, all cell positions, canvas dimensions, colors, and transparency exactly unchanged. No ladder fragments, scenery, replacement object, new text, or extra sprites. This cell must contain the character alone.
prompts.alameda:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Game Boy Color Alameda Avenue environment TILESET, not a scene.
Produce a square atlas representing EXACTLY 64x64 logical pixels, rendered at an integer nearest-neighbor enlargement. FOUR columns x FOUR rows of 16x16 logical-pixel metatiles, edge-to-edge, NO gutters, borders, labels, margins. Each metatile subdivides into four 8x8 hardware tiles. Side-on platform game viewpoint. Severe 1990s Game Boy Color pixel art, large readable pixel clusters, very few details.
Row 1 left to right: plain warm cream sky (uniform #f8e8c0); simple distant Santiago building skyline against that sky; seamless peach stucco building wall; teal recessed four-pane window in peach wall.
Row 2: solid concrete sidewalk top with a strong straight walkable upper edge; seamless concrete sidewalk fill texture; freestanding concrete platform left end against sky; matching concrete platform right end.
Row 3: LEFT HALF of a wooden public bench; matching RIGHT HALF; LEFT HALF of diagonally braced wooden rescue barricade; matching RIGHT HALF. Adjacent halves make 32x16 objects.
Row 4: LEFT HALF of a wall mural featuring abstract colorful protest hands; matching RIGHT HALF; narrow dark street lamp against cream sky; small teal street sign with a simple arrow, NO text.
For each cell use at most four colors. Palette families only:
sky/architecture #f8e8c0 #e8b884 #a86c54 #584c54;
teal architecture #f8e8c0 #a8c0ac #58a89c #304c5c;
concrete #f8e8c0 #b8b0a0 #78848c #304c5c;
wood and mural #f8e8c0 #e8b884 #a86c54 #584c54.
Shared light sky keeps a near-black dog silhouette visible. Distinguish walkable top edges from decorative structures. Flat colors, no shadows outside cells, no gradients, antialiasing, checkerboard, characters, HUD, mockup frames, or typography. Fill the ENTIRE atlas area.
prompts.campus:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Game Boy Color UNIVERSITY CAMPUS environment tile atlas.
Square 64x64 LOGICAL pixels enlarged crisply; 4 columns by 4 rows of 16x16 logical-pixel metatiles edge-to-edge. No gutters, drawn grid lines, labels, or outside margin. Every detail must survive reduction to that severe native resolution. Side-on platform game viewpoint, 1990s handheld pixel art; chunky blocks, strong horizontal platform silhouettes.
Row 1: uniform pale mint sky; university rooftop silhouette against pale mint sky; seamless warm brick wall; tall library window set in brick wall.
Row 2: rooftop walkable ledge with a straight solid top edge; seamless brick floor fill; wooden scaffold platform left end against sky; matching scaffold platform right end.

Only four colors per metatile, chosen from these palette families:
sky #e0ead0 #a8c0ac #58a89c #304c5c;
brick #f8e8c0 #e8b884 #a86c54 #584c54;
scaffold #e0ead0 #e8b884 #a86c54 #304c5c;
books/banner #f8e8c0 #ee493f #a86c54 #584c54.
Keep sky and playable backdrop light enough for a black dog to stand out. Distinguish solid platforms from decorative braces. No antialiasing, gradients, painterly texture, people, dog, HUD, text, captions, drop shadows, or mockup frame. Fill the whole atlas.
prompts.title:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: startup screen BACKGROUND art for a real Game Boy Color game, native 160 x 144 pixels, shown enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixel blocks. Aspect ratio 10:9.
Negro Matapacos, famous Chilean black street dog wearing a RED bandana, heroic friendly three-quarter SIDE PROFILE facing right, chest and front legs visible, large lean canine portrait at the CENTER of the lower two thirds. Pointed muzzle, triangular ears, calm alert expression, long face rather than a round cartoon puppy. Near-black fur with cool gray pixel highlights. Red bandana is focal point.
Composition: TOP 48 logical pixel rows are completely empty warm cream sky, reserved for title lettering that will be added later. NO objects or lettering in that upper region. Dog portrait occupies roughly x40..120, y52..118. Small Santiago skyline silhouettes and simple protest banners behind the dog at left and right, warm evening atmosphere. Bottom 16 logical pixel rows plain dark ink strip, reserved for a start prompt. No text anywhere. No borders or handheld device frame.
Style: strictly 1990s Game Boy Color pixel art with visible single native pixels, large flat clusters, NO antialiasing, gradients, painterly texture, lighting bloom, high-detail illustration, or smooth vector edges. Warm cream/peach sky, restrained teal architecture, near-black dog, gray highlights and vivid red bandana. Every 8x8 logical block should be drawable with four colors from one palette; keep color regions broad. Not a poster; a readable low-resolution startup-screen composition.
